name: iPSC tri-culture to capsule-based single-cell RNA library: Bead binding, ethanol wash and elution chip
source: Grow three iPSC-derived cell types (neurons, microglia, astrocytes) side by...
description: Generated by autochip from protocol IR 'ipsc_triculture_single_cell_capsule_rnaseq' for chip chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution (Binds cDNA to magnetic beads, washes on the magnet and elutes the library.). Flows, volumes and times the source did not give are placeholders.

steps.note: IR step 21 (bead_chamber): exchange to magnetic_beads: FEED magnetic_beads_in (magnetic_beads) at 20 uL/min, VENT bead_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Bind the released cDNA to magnetic beads.
IR step 21 (bead_chamber): load the nucleic_acid from the hand-off from chip3_lysis_rt_split_index_pcr_pool_release: syringe on inlet_1 at 20 uL/min, VENT bead_waste_out. Every other port capped.
IR step 21 (bead_chamber): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 5 min. Bind the released cDNA to magnetic beads.

IR step 22 (bead_chamber): exchange to ethanol_wash: FEED ethanol_wash_in (ethanol_wash) at 20 uL/min, VENT bead_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the beads on a magnet.

IR step 23 (bead_chamber): exchange to elution_buffer: FEED elution_buffer_in (elution_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT bead_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Elute the library from the beads.
IR step 23 (bead_chamber): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 2 min. Elute the library from the beads.

IR step 23 (bead_chamber): collect the library: FEED elution_buffer_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip4_bead_binding_wash_elution: library after step 23'. Every other port capped.
